description: Election Commission - Selected W. K. Kumareshan as the member of the Kandy M/C
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in the office of a member of the Kandy Municipal Council, which is a process governed by the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically deals with electoral procedures, including the resignation of a member, the nomination process by a political party, and the official declaration of a new member. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
